name: Broccoli Cheddar Keto Quiche

fit.note: 573 cal within 400-650; 13.3g carbs well under 35g; vegetarian, no seafood; almond-flour-crust quiche scales to 14 servings as a batch bake. Upper-half on calories but clears the ceiling.

dupe_evidence: No egg/quiche/frittata dish exists in the catalog digest (only chicken/beef/pork/turkey groups). Catalog 'Ground Turkey Broccoli Cheddar Rice Skillet' and 'Turkey Sausage Hash Brown Breakfast Bake' are turkey rice-skillet/hash-brown-bake dishes, not egg quiches. Not a duplicate.
borderline_flags: Adjacent to accepted 'crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche' (also a keto quiche), but filling differs materially: bacon+gruyere non-vegetarian vs broccoli+cheddar vegetarian, plus almond-flour crust vs crustless. Judged different dinners, KEEP, but flagged so the decider can confirm the catalog wants two keto quiches.
Shares the broccoli-cheddar flavor with accepted 'keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole', but that is a turkey casserole vs this egg quiche - different structure and protein.
cross_protein_collisions: Structurally a crustless/low-carb egg bake; a sausage, ham, or turkey version of the same broccoli-cheddar quiche/egg-bake could exist in another selector's pool - decider should watch for a meat-added twin of this exact dish.

Broccoli-cheddar flavor overlaps turkey items already accepted (keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole) and catalog (Ground Turkey Broccoli Cheddar Rice Skillet); this is the meatless egg-quiche take, distinct format.
